title: Historical activation registry for the 13 locked reservoir operators
parameter_policy: R2 tau=180 day, inflow response=0.25, drawdown=0.00 and all capacities/topology remain frozen
activation_semantics: First impoundment when available; otherwise first verified operation; year-only dates use July 1 and month-only dates use the first day

state_semantics.active_after_1961: starts empty and fills from modeled inflow

forbidden: instantaneous injection of target storage at activation
